children.name: p1
children.content: We're here to remake consumer electronics to respect people and the planet. Unlike most products, ours are open for you to repair, customize, upgrade, and own at the deepest level.

children.name: p2
children.content: Consumer electronics follows a few of the opposite principles of what makes consumer products useful, reliable, and durable over time. We’ve optimized every experience of use and service over product lifecycle and have done this through decisions that increase short-term business metrics while reducing long-term value.

children.name: p3
children.content: It doesn’t have to be this way. There are sensible patterns where products are designed from the start to be repaired and upgraded over years. The constraints in materials, supply chains, and energy use are real, but this is exactly where better design and open standards can create long-term value.

children.name: p4
children.content: Every company can align with this but not every model supports any part of it. We believe that when products are durable, modular, and maintained transparently, customers get better experiences and less waste over time.
Framework was founded in San Francisco in 2020, with a mission to remake consumer electronics to respect people and the planet.
Framework Laptop shipped with full repairability and expansion support. We launched parts, guides, and upgrades together with the product.
We announced and delivered major upgrades while maintaining compatibility. Core modules and accessories continued to expand.
Introduced more product variants and opened new manufacturing and logistics paths while keeping repair-first principles.
Framework Desktop entered development and new ecosystem parts shipped. Community contributions accelerated across regions.
Expanded platform support and scale while preserving the promise of longevity, upgradeability, and transparent documentation.

children.name: w1
children.content:
Where we are and where we
manufacture

children.name: w2
children.content: We're headquartered in San Francisco, with several offices in Taipei. Most of our manufacturing is in Taiwan, and we have team members in Seattle, EU, and all over the world.

children.content: Deploy modular laptops across your organization.

children.name: heroSub
children.content: Deploy modular laptops across your organization.

children.name: cTitle
children.content:
Customize, upgrade,
repair: The choice is yours

children.name: cSub
children.content: Standardize devices that can be upgraded and repaired in-house. Reduce e-waste and total cost of ownership.
Configure your laptop the way you work. Upgrade and repair when your needs evolve over time.
Scale up performance with modular options. Keep devices in service with easy parts replacement.
Compact desktop power with maintainable internals. Built for long-term fleet reliability.
Choose ports and modules for each role. Swap and customize without replacing the whole device.

children.name: t1q
children.content: "The laptops were exactly what we needed for developers and design teams."

children.name: t2q
children.content: "Framework systems simplified IT support and helped reduce e-waste over time."

children.name: t3q
children.content: "The modular approach gives us confidence that these systems can adapt with our teams."
Framework offers a unique approach to supporting IT budgets by keeping devices in service longer through modular upgrades and repairability.
Framework supports multiple operating systems with enterprise-ready flexibility for Windows and Linux deployments.

children.content: We're here to remake consumer electronics to respect people and the planet. Unlike most products, ours are open for you to repair, customize, upgrade, and own at the deepest level.

children.name: p2
children.content: Consumer electronics follows a few of the opposite principles of what makes consumer products useful, reliable, and durable over time. We’ve optimized every experience of use and service over product lifecycle and have done this through decisions that increase short-term business metrics while reducing long-term value.

children.name: p3
children.content: It doesn’t have to be this way. There are sensible patterns where products are designed from the start to be repaired and upgraded over years. The constraints in materials, supply chains, and energy use are real, but this is exactly where better design and open standards can create long-term value.

children.name: p4
children.content: Every company can align with this but not every model supports any part of it. We believe that when products are durable, modular, and maintained transparently, customers get better experiences and less waste over time.
Framework was founded in San Francisco in 2020, with a mission to remake consumer electronics to respect people and the planet.
Framework Laptop shipped with full repairability and expansion support. We launched parts, guides, and upgrades together with the product.
We announced and delivered major upgrades while maintaining compatibility. Core modules and accessories continued to expand.
Introduced more product variants and opened new manufacturing and logistics paths while keeping repair-first principles.
Framework Desktop entered development and new ecosystem parts shipped. Community contributions accelerated across regions.
Expanded platform support and scale while preserving the promise of longevity, upgradeability, and transparent documentation.
